abstract: BACKGROUND: Mature cystic teratomas of the major salivary glands are rare. This report describes a case of a mature cystic teratoma of the left parotid gland, including the cytologic and histopathologic findings. CASE: A 17-year-old young woman presented with a slow-growing left parotid mass that had been present for 4 years. Preoperative fine needle aspiration cytology showed the presence of acinar and ductal cells, foamy cells and multinucleated giant cells. Imprint cytology of the surgical material showed the presence of some squamous cells and sebaceous gland-like cells with hair shafts. Cellular atypia was inconspicuous. Grossly, the 3-cm lesion was unicystic and embedded within the parotid gland parenchyma. Microscopically, the inner surface of the cyst was lined with keratinized squamous epithelium. The cyst wall contained skin adnexa such as sebaceous, eccrine and apocrine glands, as well as hair follicles. Some mature cartilage tissue was also detected. Foreign body granulomatous change was seen focally. No immature tissue or malignant transformation was found. CONCLUSION: There is no previous report describing the cytologic findings of a mature cystic teratoma of the parotid gland. Mature cystic teratomas should therefore be considered in the differential diagnosis of a cystic lesion of the parotid
abstract_ja: 背景：唾液腺主要部の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は稀である。本報告は、左耳下腺の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例を、細胞学的所見と病理組織学的所見を含めて述べる。症例：17歳の女性が、4年間にわたり徐々に増大する左耳下腺腫瘤を呈した。術前の穿刺吸引細胞診では腺房細胞、導管細胞、泡沫細胞、多核巨細胞が認められた。手術材料の捺印細胞診では、扁平上皮細胞、皮脂腺様細胞、毛幹が認められた。肉眼的に、3cmの病変は単房性で、耳下腺実質内に埋もれていた。組織学的には、嚢胞内面は角化扁平上皮で覆われ、嚢胞壁には皮脂腺、エクリン腺、アポクリン腺、毛包などの皮膚付属器が含まれていた。成熟した軟骨組織も認められた。異物型肉芽腫性変化が限局して認められたが、未熟組織や悪性転化は認めなかった。結論：耳下腺の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の細胞学的所見の報告はこれまでにない。本疾患は、耳下腺の嚢胞性病変の鑑別診断に含めるべきである。
